claims.claim_text: Democrats commit to investing in training and education that equip incumbent job-holders for the new economic environment and give them access to broad knowledge and practical tools offered by apprenticeships, internships and postsecondary education.

Democrats recognize the special value and importance of Historically Black Colleges and Universities and other minority-serving institutions in meeting the needs of increasingly diverse American society.
Democrats commit to continuing support for programs, especially Pell Grants, that improve low-income Americans' opportunities to attend college.
